# Kacker–Okapuu: tip-clearance loss

[Previous: Kacker–Okapuu: trailing-edge loss](03_ko_trailing.md) · [Section index](../readme.md) · [Next: Candidate coefficient conversions](05_conversions.md)

Comparison recorded on 2026-10-17: **previous implementation (baseline)** versus **revised implementation (candidate)**. These are individual-function results; [return to the audit overview](../../readme.md) for stage-level evidence.

## Functions and dependencies

`get_tip_clearance_loss`.

## Observed behavior

The active rotor law is linear in gap/H with an artificial 1e-9 offset; it is already smooth but leaves a small nonzero loss at zero clearance. Stator clearance loss is zero.

## Implemented changes

Removed only the 1e-9 offset. Both stator and rotor now have exact zero-clearance limits, and the active linear rotor law retains finite monotone growth. No new smoothing band is needed.

## Baseline versus candidate

![ko_clearance_clearance: values and d/dx](../figures/ko_clearance_clearance.png)

![ko_clearance_aspect_ratio: values and d/dx](../figures/ko_clearance_aspect_ratio.png)

Solid: preserved baseline; dashed: revised candidate. Both use the same inputs, 200 base points and shared adaptive refinement. Right panels are d/dx, including logarithmic x axes. NaN value gaps remain explicit; omitted close derivative support does not delete value records.

## Quantitative checks

Reference check `zero_rotor_clearance`: baseline **2.67917566e-09**, candidate **0**.

10 fundamental sweeps for this mechanism. [Value/gradient data and manifest](../data/sweep_manifest.json), [first-derivative convergence](../data/provenance/fundamental_join_intervals.csv), [second-derivative convergence](../data/provenance/fundamental_curvature_intervals.csv). C2 claims additionally use endpoint regression tests; C1 table interpolation and retained C1 branches are explicitly distinguished.

## Remaining limitations

The historical documented 0.78 exponent and row/shroud applicability remain unresolved source questions. They were not restored. Retained grazing-angle clipping is outside this zero-limit fix.
